purpose.objective: Replace the failed v2.1 rehearsal harness with a single-authority-module v2.2 harness and make rehearsal attempts repeatable only when every attempt is durably and completely disclosed.

rehearsal_attempt_policy.property_being_protected: A determinism claim must not be obtained by silently rerunning and cherry-picking one passing attempt.
rehearsal_attempt_policy.why_single_use_is_not_selected: A single rehearsal attempt converts every harness defect into a version cycle without providing stronger disclosure than a complete immutable attempt history.
rehearsal_attempt_policy.protection_mechanism: Every started attempt, failure, incomplete attempt, implementation epoch, authorization, evidence inventory, and first validated candidate is durably ordered and bound into the final bundle and release receipt.

narrowly_superseded_v2_1_rehearsal_rules.v2_2_value: a failed or incomplete attempt permits only the next separately authorized disclosed ordinal; a validated candidate still forbids every later attempt

narrowly_superseded_v2_1_rehearsal_rules.previous_value: action-time owner authorization for exactly one official registered attempt with zero retry
narrowly_superseded_v2_1_rehearsal_rules.v2_2_value: retained independently for every ordinal; it no longer caps the whole series at one ordinal

narrowly_superseded_v2_1_rehearsal_rules.previous_value: registered destination and derived durable claim both absent immediately before the only authorized attempt
narrowly_superseded_v2_1_rehearsal_rules.v2_2_value: destination and series ledger absent before ordinal 1; later ordinals require exact existing ledger rehash and the destination still absent

fields_explicitly_retained: each action-time owner authorization permits exactly one ordinal
automatic retry count is zero inside every attempt
series ledger state is acquired and fsynced before every pipeline start
all failure and incomplete records remain permanently disclosed
unknown or drifted state fails closed

immutability against host administrator or physical-disk mutation

series_ledger_contract.root_creation: mkdir mode 0700, no symlink, fsync parent, before first attempt pipeline
series_ledger_contract.concurrency_policy: nonblocking exclusive flock held from ordinal allocation through terminal or process exit
series_ledger_contract.ordinal_rule: strictly contiguous with no gap duplicate reuse or reorder
series_ledger_contract.attempt_record_formula: SHA256(utf8('p4.2a-rehearsal-v2.2-attempt-record-v1\0') || ordinal_u64be || attempt_token_digest_32_bytes || started_sha256_digest_32_bytes || candidate_sha256_digest_or_zero32 || terminal_sha256_digest_or_zero32 || evidence_tree_root_digest_32_bytes)
series_ledger_contract.live_ledger_exact_member_rule: series.json, .series.lock, every regular started.json, candidate.json, terminal.json, and attempts/%06d/evidence/** file; directories are not leaves and any other entry rejects
series_ledger_contract.attempt_evidence_write_rule: every actual evidence byte used or cited by an attempt is written beneath its evidence root, fsynced, never deleted, and archived byte-for-byte
series_ledger_contract.evidence_subtree_becomes_immutable: at candidate.json or terminal.json fsync, or when a later invocation acquires the series lock and classifies a started-only attempt
series_ledger_contract.evidence_relative_path_basis: POSIX path relative to attempts/%06d/evidence with that root prefix excluded
series_ledger_contract.evidence_relative_path_normalization: nonempty ASCII matching ^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$, forward slash separators, no leading slash, no empty dot or dot-dot segment, no trailing slash, no backslash or NUL, and round-trip Path.resolve must remain beneath the exact attempt evidence root
series_ledger_contract.terminal_artifact_inventory_relative_pat: exactly the same normalized evidence_relative_path used by the evidence leaf
series_ledger_contract.bundle_attempt_artifact_relative_path: exactly the same normalized evidence_relative_path; archive_relative_path is a separate field and is never hashed as the live evidence path
series_ledger_contract.started_only_record_derivation: candidate_digest=zero32, terminal_digest=zero32, outcome=INCOMPLETE_UNTERMINALIZED, and evidence root is the recomputed persisted evidence tree or the exact empty root
series_ledger_contract.previous_history_root_for_next_attempt: recompute every earlier record in ordinal order from live bytes; never accept a caller-supplied root without recomputation
